This sits against negative 12h and 24h returns, negative multi-horizon aggressive quote flow, ETH underperformance, and an earlier weak rich-breadth proxy. The evidence is mixed rather than a clear continuation, re-acceleration, or persistent late-cycle deterioration signal. Breadth snapshots have different membership; the rich-breadth data are proxy-only; ETF evidence is one settled session; and option skew is a current-chain moneyness measure, not 25-delta skew. The 1h API horizon is unavailable and the supplied temporal-coherence check reports an existing hourly contract violation, limiting short-horizon interpretation. Phase and warning are shadow-only descriptions.
